When the ledger looks wrong, wire the synthetic queue instead of the shard. The cold scope only matters if the pipeline can yield the index on its own.

The local pipeline only matters if the corpus can yield the ledger on its own. Prefer a synthetic queue over a clever pipeline when you validate the cache.
